intro: Your costume took days and your caption gets ten seconds. Here are 100 original Halloween captions, grouped by the kind of post. Tap Copy next to any line and paste it into Instagram.

All of them are written for this page and free to use, and most read fine in lowercase. There is a whole section for ghosts, because we did a ghost photoshoot and have opinions. Photos by @solo.stasera.

sections.lead: For the bedsheet photos. Deadpan works best, since the ghost is already doing the joke.
captions: i ghost everyone. it's nothing personal
laundry day got out of hand
off to haunt someone who deserves it
there's a ghost on the swing and she's fine
my spirit left and took the good sheets
sorry i ghosted you, it's seasonal
you can't see me, but i can see your stories

sections.lead: A pun is allowed once a year. This is the day.
captions: i'm just here for the boos
dressed as someone with their life together. very scary
this costume cost more than my rent

the only thing scary here is my bank balance
my favourite day to look like this on purpose

sections.lead: One to three words, for when the costume is already loud enough.
Quiet, lowercase and slightly unsettling. Good for dusk light and dark photos.

sections.h2: How to write a good Halloween caption
sections.lead: Say what the photo isn't saying. If the costume is scary, make the caption boring. If the costume is silly, make it deadly serious.
sections.html:
• Play against the picture. A terrifying ghost captioned "laundry day got out of hand" beats "so spooky!"
  • Use one pun, not three. One is charming. Three is a greeting card.
  • Add a detail only you know. "the costume didn't last the night" makes people ask.
  • Post close to the day. Halloween posts are mostly looked at in the last week of October and the first days of November.
  • Tag whoever is under the sheet. Nobody can tell otherwise.

faq.q: What is a good Halloween caption for Instagram?
faq.a: A short line that plays against the photo, such as "sheet happens" under a bedsheet ghost or "here for the free candy" under a dramatic costume.

faq.q: What is a good caption for a ghost photo?
faq.a: Deadpan lines work best: "i'm not antisocial, i'm dead", "laundry day got out of hand" or "ghosted, but make it fashion".

faq.q: What is a short Halloween caption?
faq.a: "stay spooky", "creep it real", "oh my gourd" or simply "boo." all work when the photo does the talking.

faq.q: Can I use these captions for free?
faq.a: Yes. They are original lines written for this page, free to copy and change.

faq.q: When should I post Halloween photos?
faq.a: Inspiration and how-to posts do best a week or two before Halloween, while costume photos and dumps suit the day itself and the days just after.

signoff: I still think "sheet happens" is the one to beat. If one of these ends up under your photo, tag me so I can see it.
